reviews.text: Fantastic vets, have helped my cat so much and everyone really cares. Really good prices too. Would highly recommend

This practice failed to provide assistance in case of a serious emergency. Lack of ethics and training from the staff. I’ve been registered here for the past 5 years and the way they addressed an emergency with my dog that I had found home dying was appalling.
If a vet is nearby and available (on lunch break I was told several times when I called and visited the practice with my dog in distress) it is an ethical obligation to provide assistance. The vet arrived afterwards in a minute so they were free. Alternatively they should be able to provide the contact details of a nearby emergency unit.
A few minutes after my dog passed away in the waiting room they asked me if I wanted to take the body home (?), couldn't be more wrong on the timing and empathy. Not blaming them for the events and the death of my sweet dog but for the lack of professionalism and knowledge to handle such a situation. The vet didn’t take more than a few minutes with me and wouldn’t discuss any possible causes. I have reported it to the owner who apologised but this is too serious for me not to report it publicly.

We then requested a post mortem / autopsy which was conducted by an external lab. Over the following months I had to chase to get hold of someone and the results, I was told on email the final report was available but only managed to speak to someone 10 days later. Serious issues of communication again, and unacceptable to be left in the dark during such a critical time.

At the end of day, we will never know for sure what happened to my dear dog, nothing was found in the autopsy. May be a cardiac failure. The practice’s owner took time with me on the phone during these next stages, but the harm done from the lack of consideration, support and assistance on the day is unbearable and unacceptable.

Brockwell Vets are great. I am based on Briton Hill and had been using my local Goddard's where were useless, had a different vet every time. At Brockwell you see the same vets and they know and take and interest in my dog. Couldn't recommend them enough!
They were brilliant and very efficient indeed.
Excellent veterinary, sensible decision about my old cat. Her life has been prolonged for a significant amount of time.
All the staff here were Friendly and very helpful. My kitten was well taken cared for

We’ve only been here once for Suki’s intake but have since been back various times to use their scales and weigh her in. An absolutely BRILLIANT team.

The vet there did Suki’s check up and some outstanding vaccinations and honestly - this was our first week of having our puppy - he couldn’t have been any more helpful, kind and overall just amazing. He really took the time to chat to us - alleviate any concerns and give us tips. Just wanted to say thank you for that and we’ll definitely be back!
I feel like they scam me and i got harness cost 20 quid

While not local to us, this is our Vet.
The commute is worth it.
Staff are so friendly and informed.
Prices are reasonable too.

We recently switched to Brockwell Veterinary Surgery from another practice on the other side of the park, and I’m so glad we did.
We had what turned into an urgent situation, and they managed to see us the same day, which was a huge relief. The staff were all incredibly kind and welcoming, and the level of care was outstanding.
Emma, the vet who treated our dog, was excellent. She carried out a very thorough examination and explained everything clearly. After discovering he had swallowed coins, she quickly arranged an X-ray, confirmed the issue, and then organised a same-day referral for endoscopic removal. The whole process was handled efficiently and without unnecessary delays.
What really stood out was how practical and sensible the approach was — no wasted time, no unnecessary costs, just clear decision-making and fast action when it mattered.
The pricing was also very reasonable, especially compared to our previous vet.
I’m genuinely very happy we made the switch and would highly recommend Brockwell Veterinary Surgery to anyone looking for a competent, responsive, and caring veterinary practice.

Thank you so so much

Honestly, we've been to so many vets over the years, but Brockwell Vets is hands down the best we've ever found.

Will is just brilliant – so caring, really gets what you and your pet are going through, and works super hard. We honestly wouldn't go anywhere else now.

A massive thank you to Will, and a special shout-out to the really helpful reception team too – they always make things so easy!

I have been wanting  to put this review for some time , I have been using this vet for many many years , and I could not recommend it more , i feel very lucky to have this  vet that is straight up , and honest , and gives you time , actually goes through every thing , you don’t feel it’s a rushed situation at all ,  I will like to add that Will (vet) is amazing , and has been a blessing to see when going to the vet is usually not good for all (human and pet)

Thank you

Amir
My beloved Xiaohuang passed away peacefully there at the age of 14 and 8 months. Thank you for handling this delicate moment with such kindness and care. Here is when she was 2 months old.

All the staff at Brockwell Vets have been so kind and accommodating. Our rescue hound is very reactive to other dogs so vet visits can be tricky but the team at Brockwell Vets go above and beyond to make everything as seamless and stress free as possible - we are so so grateful for their thoughtfulness and care.
Ellie was very professional and sweet to our boy teddy, answered all our questions and was super helpful! Thank you 🙏 …
Thank you Will and the team for accommodating for Bertie’s needs and advice on an adhoc bases.Very friendly practice and Will explained everything so well . Thank you again

This isn't our usual vets (though we would be very happy to change for them to be our regular vets) but we have been here on two occassions as they are helpfully open on a Saturday. The first occassion was after our dog unfortunately ate a big avocado pip, and the staff were very friendly and helped us see a vet quickly to help my dog vomit up the avocado pip - she was absolutely fine after this. Our second visit was last weekend, as our dog had seemed lethargic for a while - not her useful hyper self - and had lost her appetite. The vet found some time to see her in between booked consultations, and quickly realised it was an emergency after seeing some blood test results. He and the very helpful receptionist helped find an out of hours emergency veterinary practice that was able to take our dog Bella for a blood transfusion, and we just got her back this morning after her transfusion and two days of hospitalisation. We are very very grateful for Brockwell vets for seeing us, spotting the emergency and helping Bella get the care she needs (as we're scared to think what may have happened otherwise!!)

I’ve used this vets several times over the years and they’ve always been compassionate and will always see an animal very promptly. I have to say the girls in reception are a credit to the practise what sweethearts . I’d like to particularly thank the girl that spoke to a tearful me in the phone this morning and helped me facilitate an injured mouse rescue by giving me all the advice and helped I needed just when I really needed someone to care enough about this tiny baby… all other vets had been cold hearted about the situation and the vet was kind enough to give advice and time too. Thankyou

Hi Kelly, 
My name is Will Chandler, one of the owners at Brockwell. Struggling to find details of a file matching your name. Would you be able to email me on info@brockwellvets.co.uk with any feedback. Clearly we did something that fell short of your expectations and I would like to find out what happened. Your input would be massively appreciated. Hope all is well. 
Kind regards,
 Will

Our dear Cat Persia 🐈 arrived home this evening having had dental surgery at Brockwell. Will - The Veternary Surgeon who performed the procedure was kind and professional. He gave me detailed feed back after examing Persia before and after the surgery. The receptionists and the team were and are fabulous. Persia was cared for throughout the day. The whole team were courteous and friendly and I can see they have a real concern for their patients and relatives. I want to personally thank the team for such tender loving care of our beloved Persia and for their professionalism. Priscilla, Persia's Sister was treated with more or less the same procedure last year and had a speedy recovery so I'm sure Persia will follow suit. Would highly recommend them. 🐱🐱
They were brilliant thank you

Highly recommend! Extremely caring, friendly and responsive team. My dog had her keyhole neutering surgery and was looked after brilliantly. Healed quickly without any issues. Extremely pleased with the service and support. Thank you!

I have been coming to this practice with my cats since Jenny started it which must be 25+ years by now. I have seen lots of changes all good, but one thing has never changed everyone in the practice is kind, empathetic, responsive and incredibly competent.  Today they fitted me in with my cat who had gone AWOL at the sight of the cellar door opening,  evening before the cat carrier appeared. I missed the appointment but my cat was spotted in my neighbours garden, I grabbed him and they fitted him in . I am so grateful he had a nasty wound and was becoming more unwell.  Special thanks to the lovely helpful considerate Veterinary nurse and to Jenny for treating my cat and reassuring me. Geraldine and Yoda ( and Kiko, who did not need you today!)

Super happy with this vet surgery!
Jenny is an amazing vet, so is her team. —Jenny gives excellent advice and never pushes unnecessary medications or treatments like my previous vet did.
I switched to Brockwell Surgery about a year ago from a big chain based on a friend’s recommendation, and I’m so glad I did. It was definitely the right decision.

The whole team is professional and friendly. The ladies at the reception are always warm and welcoming. I highly recommend them!

This vet was highly recommended by some volunteers of a London cat rescue charity, and I'm so glad I chose them. All the receptionists and vets were kind, accommodating, and gave my cat excellent care (for a very painful, scratched eye) when he needed an emergency appointment - and in subsequent apps too. Thank you so much Brockwell vets!

I can’t speak highly enough about Brockwell Veterinary Surgery! I felt welcomed and reassured. The staff at the front desk were friendly and efficient, and the waiting area was clean and calm.

Dr. Chandler took great care of my hamster, and treated her with genuine care and patience.

Thank you!

Having experienced a great deal of differing standards of care over the many years as a pet owner (at one time x40 within my care) & as an assured Kennel club breeder of Minature short haired Dachshunds, I couldn't be more delighted to have discovered Brockwell Vets. The welcome by the reception staff  & Will & level of veterinary knowledge was exceptional with Warren going over & beyond with his advice on the varying medical & less main stream options available. I felt listened to & had every question methodically answered.
I know our four -leggeds are in really safe hands 🙏🏻

Absolutely Disgusted – Avoid Brockwell Vets at All Costs!!

We took our beloved cat to Brockwell Vets after noticing she was rapidly losing weight and not acting like herself. We were deeply worried and spent hundreds of pounds on blood tests, only to be told they didn’t know what was wrong. No real answers, no clear direction—just more suggestions for expensive tests.

Over the next few weeks, our cat continued to deteriorate, she lost her appetite, became lethargic, and was clearly suffering. When we called Brockwell Vets again, they said it would cost £760 for scans and X-rays to “maybe” find out what was wrong. Given our experience so far, we were skeptical. It felt like they cared more about draining our wallets than actually helping our cat.

Since we couldn’t afford that kind of cost and had lost faith in their care, we went to another vet. They ran a simple set of blood and urine tests and within a day they told us that our cat is in kidney failure. We are devastated that precious time was wasted, and we believe Brockwell Vets could have and should have caught this earlier.

If they had prioritised proper, thorough care instead of pushing costly procedures, maybe we’d have had a chance to help her sooner. We are heartbroken and angry. We’ll never take any of our pets back to this clinic. If you love your pets, stay far away from Brockwell Vets. In our experience, they are more interested in profit than in providing real, compassionate veterinary care.

I’m incredibly grateful to Will and the entire team at Brockwell Veterinary Surgery  for the care they gave to my dog.He recently had to undergo surgery, and throughout the entire process, we felt completely supported and reassured.
Will is an outstanding vet—professional, kind, and clearly very knowledgeable. He took the time to explain everything and made sure I understood each step of Moony’s treatment. It gave me real peace of mind knowing Moony was in such capable hands.
The reception team is also amazing. The girls at the front desk are always polite, welcoming, and helpful—it really makes a difference when you’re going through something stressful with your pet.

Thank you again to everyone! You’ve taken such good care of Moony, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend you to any pet owner.

I would give 0 🌟 if I could.

The vet L. D (lady) saw our pet.

Treatment very cold, harsh with the puppy. It didn't explain properly... I found it very expensive for the 10 minutes of pushing, painfully a thermometer into the puppy back side, then the injection...all super harsh. Didn't show any touch of care towards the puppy.

Information given was mixed and at the end she didn't give the treatment so I can return tomorrow for test... at the end said the uppy look good...

Then everyone is kind of kicking u out the shop....

I'll not book again and I will not recommend this place.

I brought in our Cat on Monday as he was very unwell.
Reception staff were friendly , were empathetic.

The female vet who treated him in his last moments was patient and clear in explaining what would happen next.
Everything happened so quick and UNFORTUNATELY there was nothing that could be done for our lovely cat and he had to be euthanised.
It absolutely broke my heart and I broke down but the vet and reception staff were patient and compassionate towards me.

Thank you for everything even though nothing could be done but put him at peace 😢🙁

Thank you for sending us his paw prints in a card it really helped us on our journey as my children were at school and didn’t have a chance to say their last goodbyes.
What a lovely message.

I will definitely bring in our future pet when we are ready to get a cat.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts ♥️ for treating him with the utmost dignity and respect.

Kind regards
Amal
A proper vet practise. I swapped from a big chain of vets and couldn't believe the difference. They really care and take time to explain options. The costs were much better than the chain too.

I did all the process (except rabies vaccination) for my Pomeranian to travel with me in Ghana with this clinic . There explained me all the process and help me a lot . The price are reasonable but not cheap of course.
I recommend 100%

We took our very old and incredibly sick dog here, Will (the vet) explained everything to us very carefully and professionally. Ultimately, we had to euthanise her but it was done with such a huge amount of compassion and care. We were quite distraught and all of the staff handled us with care..
I would very highly recommend.

Will was our vet at the Camberwell Medivet. We changed to Brockwell Vets when he became a partner there, even though it is further from us and entails taking the bus with my extremely nervous dog - which really is no small matter.

Having a Vet that you can trust to provide the best care for your pet, with no other consideration trumping that fundamental principle, is incredibly valuable. Will is also extremely knowledgeable, and he is always happy to explain in depth anything that you wish to understand.

I am secure in the knowledge that my dog is in the best possible hands.
Caring and helpfully explained the necessary treatment
Very caring practice. Will and Jenny build up trust in patients and their owners. As a result my elderly dog loves going to the vet because they make sure that it’s a positive experience.

An excellent independent vet. We have taken Toshi, our bedlington whippet, to this vet since she was a tiny puppy. The vets are friendly, caring and knowledgeable. They performed Toshi’s keyhole surgery for spaying and the whole team were excellent throughout. Shout out also to the reception staff who are always lovely and helpful. A rare find in a market saturated by faceless chains.

Switched to Brockwell Vets a few years ago and have had nothing but great experiences with them. The reception staff are helpful and friendly. The vets are knowledgeable and show genuine care for pets. Vet Will in particular has been brilliant. He is very attentive and really thorough in his explanation helping you to understand the diagnosis and possible risks but in a very reassuring manner. The best vet surgery we have tried for our dog who has had quite a few issues.

I would just like to say a HUGE thank you to Will and the 2 ladies who were manning reception on the evening of Thursday 16th Jan 2025. My dear old Cat (who was a rescue cat from this very Vets practise 11 years ago) was quite unwell and as …

Switched to this practice a few months ago, largely because of costs at our old vets (a big chain), but also struggling to connect with several of the vets that were brought in there. I cannot recommend Brockwell surgery enough. Much better …

Had a wonderful experience getting our 11 month female dog Spayed. From the initial call, pre visit, op and collecting her everyone was lovely, caring and professional. Will the vet even sorted her itching and nails while he had her. …

We've been bringing our rabbits here for several years and have always been very pleased with the service. They always do their best to fit you in and we liked all the vets we've seen. Most recently our rabbit took longer to recover from an …

Took my sister's cat after he was in a road accident. They kept him overnight before looking at him to determine problems / possible treatment. In the morning he was crying and we wonder if they even sedated him overnight. Female vet fairly …
Helpful, efficient and professional as always. Many thanks.

I am very impressed with this surgery and its team. My rescue dog Mia developed chronic diarrhea after eating something in the park, and two weeks later, she caught giardia. The first vet prescribed antibiotics that Mia refused to eat. When …

I had a great experience today with the lovely staff, and I love that the people who work there are so kind and caring- I  especially want to thank the veterinary nurse Nicola who has been brilliant in helping me over the years with both of my cats.
